INDEPENDENT DEVELOPER

Rig → Animate → Implement

Prepared firearm rigs and action animations in Blender, edited animation curves, and built UE5 animation state machines driven by player input and game state. Includes magazine inspection and an ammunition display.

Physical ballistics

Implemented physical projectiles with bullet drop and ricochet simulation. Test targets fracture on projectile impact, connecting the firing model to environmental feedback.

Location-based reactions

Hit detection distinguishes impact locations and triggers different physics-driven responses: collapse after a leg hit, or a backward stagger or fall after a torso impact.
